Problem: POMDP decision-making for UAV search and rescue in GNSS-denied indoors

Title: A Tree-Based Next-Best-Trajectory Method for 3-D UAV Exploration

Title: Autonomous BIM-Aware UAV Path Planning for Construction Inspection

Title: Distributed Collaborative Complete Coverage Path Planning Based on Hybrid Strategy

Title: A multi-UAV cooperative route planning methodology for 3D fine-resolution building model reconstruction
Problem: multi-UAV cooperative route planning for 3D building reconstruction

Title: Fast Unfolding-Based Indoor Space Partitioning and Rapid Complementary Search Planning for High-Rise Fire Rescue
Problem: multi-UAV complementary coverage search in indoor high-rise fire rescue

Title: Model-based analysis of multi-UAV path planning for surveying postdisaster building damage
